turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy from Lucknow?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Reddy. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, my name is Rohan from the Digital Security Wing. We noticed some suspicious login attempts on your banking app from a different city.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? But I am at home only. Is my money safe?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is safe for now, but we must secure your account immediately. Please download the AnyDesk app from the play store so I can guide you through the security settings.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: AnyDesk? I do not know how to do this. Can you not just fix it from your office?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I need to see your screen to block the hackers, sir. Just open the app and tell me the nine digit code showing on your screen.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, wait one minute. The code is 421 883 901.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you, I have accessed the system. Now, to verify the account ownership and reverse the pending fraudulent charge, you must transfer fifty thousand rupees to our secure government verification vault.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Fifty thousand? That is too much, why should I send money to fix a problem?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, this is a refundable security deposit. If you do not do this now, your account will be frozen by the RBI within ten minutes.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am getting very worried. Let me call my son first.
